title: An item's touches tell the docs it may edit from the docs it only reviews, and only edits serialise items
goal: Answers the SP-vmxdxtru retrospective: seven of its eight work items named kb/_self/code.md in their touches (map.csv maps every _tools module to it), none edited it, and the shared touch made the sprint one serial chain of eight steps. An item's touches mark a doc it only reads and names in Self-Reviewed apart from a file it edits; the overlap rule of held, next and check's serial-chain warning counts only edits; done still refuses an edit outside the edit touches; the runbook and the sprint and backlog skills say how to mark each.
